contract_origin: Authored bounded test of recovered R080 title; alpha chosen as unsupported property of ordinary VP8 stream. HDR is a different unqualified profile.
mechanism: Decode independent ordinary opaque VP8 color and mask streams, align exact timestamp/dimensions, recover mask luma as alpha.
baseline: Existing native transparent WebM from same encoded color/mask payloads.
correctness: All3 frames alphaMax<=2,premultipliedRGBMax<=3 vs originalRGBA; timestamp mismatch rejection; backward seek and EOF baseline; candidate reset/close.
performance: 9 alternating pairs full decode+reconstruction vs native transparent baseline including native seek; report unequal API scheduling, no universal codec throughput claim; success median ratio<=.95.
